passRule: PASS requires a current official host website, documentation, or repository that supports the declared plugin or plugin-compatible import route, plus a matching Hypertaks adapter or package path.

hosts.installInstruction: Open Antigravity Plugins, choose Install or Import Plugin, and select the Hypertaks Antigravity package.
hosts.updateInstruction: Use the Antigravity Plugins update or replace flow with the newer Hypertaks package.
hosts.uninstallInstruction: Remove Hypertaks from the Antigravity Plugins interface.

hosts.installInstruction: /plugin marketplace add aabrur/hypertaks-agent, then /plugin install hypertaks@hypertaks-marketplace
hosts.updateInstruction: /plugin update hypertaks@hypertaks-marketplace
hosts.uninstallInstruction: /plugin uninstall hypertaks@hypertaks-marketplace

hosts.installInstruction: codex plugin marketplace add https://github.com/aabrur/hypertaks-agent.git, then open /plugins and enable hypertaks@hypertaks-marketplace
hosts.updateInstruction: Use the Codex plugin marketplace upgrade flow, then refresh the Hypertaks plugin.
hosts.uninstallInstruction: Disable or remove hypertaks@hypertaks-marketplace from /plugins.

hosts.installInstruction: Run /add-plugin in Cursor and select or paste https://github.com/aabrur/hypertaks-agent.
hosts.updateInstruction: Update Hypertaks from Cursor Plugins.
hosts.uninstallInstruction: Remove Hypertaks from Cursor Plugins.

hosts.installInstruction: /plugins install https://github.com/aabrur/hypertaks-agent.git
hosts.updateInstruction: /plugins reload hypertaks
hosts.uninstallInstruction: /plugins remove hypertaks

hosts.installInstruction: Add the Hypertaks local plugin module to the plugin array in opencode.json.
hosts.updateInstruction: Update the Hypertaks checkout and restart OpenCode.
hosts.uninstallInstruction: Remove the Hypertaks entry from the OpenCode plugin array.

hosts.installInstruction: pi install https://github.com/aabrur/hypertaks-agent.git
hosts.updateInstruction: pi update hypertaks
hosts.uninstallInstruction: pi remove hypertaks

hosts.installInstruction: openclaw plugins install git:github.com/aabrur/hypertaks-agent@main
hosts.updateInstruction: openclaw plugins update hypertaks
hosts.uninstallInstruction: openclaw plugins uninstall hypertaks

hosts.installInstruction: hermes plugins install aabrur/hypertaks-agent --enable
hosts.updateInstruction: hermes plugins update hypertaks
hosts.uninstallInstruction: hermes plugins remove hypertaks

hosts.installInstruction: Open ChatGPT Plugins or Developer Mode, create a custom plugin app, and connect the deployed Hypertaks HTTPS MCP endpoint.
hosts.updateInstruction: Refresh the custom plugin app after deploying the newer Hypertaks runtime.
hosts.uninstallInstruction: Remove or disconnect the Hypertaks custom plugin app.

hosts.installInstruction: copilot plugin install aabrur/hypertaks-agent or /plugin install aabrur/hypertaks-agent
hosts.updateInstruction: copilot plugin update hypertaks or /plugin update hypertaks
hosts.uninstallInstruction: copilot plugin uninstall hypertaks or /plugin uninstall hypertaks

hosts.installInstruction: Open Cascade Customizations, choose Skills, and import the Hypertaks plugin bundle as Workspace or Global.
hosts.updateInstruction: Replace the Hypertaks plugin bundle through the same Skills interface.
hosts.uninstallInstruction: Remove the five Hypertaks plugin skills from Cascade Customizations.

hosts.installInstruction: cline plugin install --git https://github.com/aabrur/hypertaks-agent.git
hosts.updateInstruction: cline plugin install --force --git https://github.com/aabrur/hypertaks-agent.git
hosts.uninstallInstruction: Remove the Hypertaks entry from Cline plugin configuration.

hosts.installInstruction: For the archived final Roo Code release, import the Hypertaks plugin bundle into .roo/skills or .agents/skills.
hosts.updateInstruction: No active upstream update channel; pin the compatible Hypertaks bundle to the archived Roo Code environment.
hosts.uninstallInstruction: Remove only the five Hypertaks plugin skill directories.

hosts.installInstruction: Register file:///absolute/path/to/hypertaks-agent/plugins/kilo/hypertaks.ts in the plugin array of kilo.json.
hosts.updateInstruction: Update the Hypertaks checkout and run /reload.
hosts.uninstallInstruction: Remove the Hypertaks file URL from the Kilo plugin array.

hosts.installInstruction: Load the five Hypertaks plugin instruction files with --read, /read, or the read section of .aider.conf.yml.
hosts.updateInstruction: Update the Hypertaks bundle and restart Aider.
hosts.uninstallInstruction: Remove only the Hypertaks read references.

hosts.installInstruction: Install the Hypertaks plugin bundle through Goose Skills Marketplace or import the reviewed Hypertaks recipe.
hosts.updateInstruction: Update through the same Goose skill or recipe mechanism.
hosts.uninstallInstruction: Remove the Hypertaks skill or recipe package.

hosts.installInstruction: /plugin install github:aabrur/hypertaks-agent
hosts.updateInstruction: Reinstall or update the Hypertaks plugin from the reviewed GitHub ref.
hosts.uninstallInstruction: /plugin uninstall hypertaks

hosts.installInstruction: Open Claude Plugins, choose Upload Plugin, and upload the Hypertaks plugin package from this repository.
hosts.updateInstruction: Upload the newer Hypertaks plugin package and replace the installed version.
hosts.uninstallInstruction: Remove Hypertaks from Claude Plugins.

hosts.installInstruction: Create a Gem and import the Hypertaks plugin instruction bundle as the Gem knowledge and instructions.
hosts.updateInstruction: Replace the Gem knowledge files with the newer Hypertaks plugin bundle.
hosts.uninstallInstruction: Delete or disable the Hypertaks Gem.

hosts.installInstruction: Open Admin Panel, Workspace, Tools or Functions, then import the Hypertaks plugin adapter.
hosts.updateInstruction: Replace the Hypertaks Tool or Function through Workspace.
hosts.uninstallInstruction: Delete the Hypertaks Tool or Function from Workspace.

hosts.installInstruction: Register the Hypertaks plugin adapter as an MCP server or OpenAPI Action in LibreChat configuration.
hosts.updateInstruction: Update the Hypertaks endpoint or Action schema and restart the LibreChat deployment.
hosts.uninstallInstruction: Remove the Hypertaks MCP or Action entry from LibreChat configuration.
